name: Unidentified OOM command battle droid (Onderon)
description: An OOM command battle droid was the leader of Patrol 118 in the Separatist Droid Army. During the Onderonian Civil War, the droid led a patrol in the city of Iziz on Onderon when they were ambushed by the Onderon rebels. The droid called for reinforcements before it was destroyed by Steela Gerrera.
